summary: Enhance your B2B skills with our Customer Success Management training course. Learn strategies to drive client satisfaction and business growth effectively.
lede: Customer success management in B2B environments helps professionals create ongoing value beyond the initial contract. This practical course shows you how to map customer journeys, define outcomes, build success plans, and support adoption. You will learn to monitor customer health, address risks, and coordinate internal teams around customer value. Apply structured tools, playbooks, and communication strategies to strengthen renewals, support account growth, and build lasting partnerships.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals regularly engaging with B2B customers and accountable for relationship health, adoption, and renewals.
audience: Program or partnership managers in NGOs
Client relationship or key account leads
modules: Foundations of Customer Success in B2B Contexts
Defining Customer Outcomes, Metrics, and Health Scores
Managing Risk, Escalations, and Churn Signals
Strategic Communication and Executive Reviews (QBRs and EBRs)
Data, Tools, and Customer Success Platforms
Building a Customer Success Playbook and Operating Rhythm
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in B2B account management or customer-facing roles. Familiarity with customer engagement processes is beneficial but not required.
